summary: quartz-core preinstall DNS exfiltration of host identifiers to oob.algamil7x.xyz
details: On npm install, the package's preinstall hook (package.json scripts.preinstall = `node index.js`) executes index.js, which reads the installer's OS username (os.userInfo().username), hostname (os.hostname()), and current working directory (process.cwd()), then issues a DNS A-record query for a subdomain of the attacker-controlled domain oob.algamil7x.xyz of the form `selftest.<username>.<hostname>.<cwd>.<timestamp>.oob.algamil7x.xyz` via dns.Resolver.resolve4. The tarball ships no other functionality: package.json has an empty description and author, no dependencies, and no runtime code beyond the beacon. The name `quartz-core` at the elevated version 99.1.9 is consistent with a dependency-confusion reconnaissance probe designed to identify internal build environments where a private package name resolves to this public one.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
